The Founder and Presiding Bishop of Living Faith Church Worldwide, Bishop David Oyedepo, has re-ordained the Founder of Salvation Ministries, Pastor David Ibiyeomie, and the Founder of The Master’s Place International Church, Pastor Korede Komaiya, with a fresh mandate for greater assignments in their ministries. The re-ordination took place on Friday during the dedication of the Hand of God Cathedral in Port Harcourt, Rivers State. According to a statement issued by the Media Unit of Salvation Ministries on Monday, the exercise was described as a fresh impartation, renewed anointing and a new spiritual mantle for the two clerics. “This is not just an ordination, it is a fresh impartation. A fresh oil. A fresh mantle. A fresh fire for a new season,” the statement said. It added that Oyedepo’s laying of hands on the two pastors represented a renewal of their spiritual mandate. “When a father lays hands, heaven confirms it. The same fire that was on the altar has fallen again. The anointing has been renewed, the assignment has been reaffirmed, and the glory has increased,” it stated. The statement commended Ibiyeomie and Komaiya for their contributions to evangelism, church growth and the development of Christian leaders. “We celebrate these two mighty vessels whom God has used to raise men, build churches, win souls and spread the Gospel across nations, and now, God is taking them to another level,” it added. The statement added that members of Salvation Ministries and The Master’s Place International Church joined in celebrating the two pastors. “What a glorious moment in the Kingdom of God! This renewed impartation and fresh re-ordination would usher in greater dimensions of grace, impact, soul winning and Kingdom exploits,” it noted. Oyedepo had previously attended the dedication of Komaiya’s Master City Dreamland and Ibiyeomie’s Hand of God Cathedral, where he commended the two pastors for their contributions to the work of God.
